How to use this book

IMPULSE LEARNING CENTER
1. Read the model

Read the model text. Find the highlighted phrases and notice how the text is organised.

2. Learn the language

Study the Language focus and the Words & phrases, then do the practice.

3. Plan

Make short notes for each paragraph before you start writing.

4. Write and check

Write your text, then use the Self-check list. Compare with the model answers.

Each unit has seven parts

1 · Model text

A real example of the unit’s text type.

2 · Language focus

One writing skill with examples.

3 · Words & phrases

Ten useful collocations with Uzbek.

4 · Practice

Use the new words in sentences.

5 · Plan

Notes for each paragraph.

6 · Writing task

A real-life task with lines to write on.

7 · IELTS-style task

An opinion paragraph with ideas and a plan.

A good paragraph

TopicIn my opinion, it is important to learn a foreign language.
SupportFirstly, it gives you more job opportunities. For example, many companies want workers who speak English.
EndTo sum up, I believe everyone should learn at least one foreign language.

UNIT1

Your World

Text type: Informal email · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 1.1 · MODEL TEXT · INFORMAL EMAIL

Hi from Tashkent!

Hi Emma,

Thanks for your email. It was great to hear from you! Let me tell you a bit about myself. My name is Aziza and I’m 19. I’m from Tashkent, the capital of Uzbekistan. It’s a big, multicultural city and people here speak Uzbek and Russian.

I live with my parents and my younger brother. I’m a student at university and I study economics. In my free time, I like reading and going for walks with my friends.

I’m learning English because I want to work abroad one day. What about you? Why are you learning Uzbek?

Write back soon!

Best wishes,

Aziza

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 1.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Starting and ending an informal email

Informal emails go to friends and people you know. Start with a friendly greeting, say why you are writing, and finish with a short ending before your name.

  • StartHi Emma, / Hello Tom, / Dear Anna,
  • First lineThanks for your email. / It was great to hear from you.
  • Ask a questionWhat about you? / How are things with you?
  • Before the endWrite back soon! / I hope to hear from you soon.
  • EndBest wishes, / Take care, / Love, (for family and close friends)

UNIT 1.6 · WRITING TASK · INFORMAL EMAIL

Email to a new pen friend

You have a new pen friend from another country. Write an email to introduce yourself.

In your informal email:

  • say where you are from and describe your city
  • tell him or her about your family
  • say what you do and what you like doing
  • ask two questions about your pen friend
Write 80–100 words

Remember: starting and ending an informal email

  • StartHi Emma, / Hello Tom, / Dear Anna,
  • First lineThanks for your email. / It was great to hear from you.
  • Ask a questionWhat about you? / How are things with you?
  • Before the endWrite back soon! / I hope to hear from you soon.

Self-check

  • I answered every point in the task.
  • I used at least three phrases from the Vocabulary box.

UNIT 1.7 · IELTS-STYLE TASK · OPINION

Give your opinion

“Is it important to learn a foreign language? Why or why not?”

Write an opinion paragraph of 80–120 words. Give reasons and examples.

Ideas to help you

  • more job opportunities in the future
  • you can travel and talk to people from other countries
  • you can watch films and read books in the original language
  • it is hard and takes a lot of time

Paragraph plan

  1. 1
    Your opinion

    In my opinion, … / I think …

  2. 2
    Reason 1 + example

    Firstly, … For example, …

  3. 3
    Reason 2 or the other side

    Secondly, … / On the other hand, … However, …

  4. 4
    Conclusion

    To sum up, … / Overall, I believe …

UNIT2

My Day

Text type: Blog post: a typical day · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 2.1 · MODEL TEXT · BLOG POST: A TYPICAL DAY

A day in my life

I’m a student, so my weekdays are quite busy. As a rule, I get up at half past six. First, I have a shower and get dressed. Then I have breakfast with my family – usually bread, eggs and green tea.

At about half past seven, I take the bus to university. My first class starts at eight. I usually have lunch with my friends in the canteen.

I get home at five. After that, I do my homework and help my mum with the housework. In the evening, I hardly ever watch TV – I prefer reading or chatting with friends online.

Finally, I go to bed at about eleven. I’m definitely a morning person!

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 2.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Time order words and how often

Use sequencing words to show the order of your day. Put frequency adverbs before the main verb, but after the verb “be”.

  • OrderFirst, … Then … After that, … Finally, …
  • Timeat 7 o’clock · in the morning · on Saturdays · at the weekend
  • Frequencyalways · usually · often · sometimes · hardly ever · never
  • PositionI usually get up at 7. / I am always tired on Mondays.
  • Longeronce a week · twice a day · every evening

UNIT3

Work

Text type: Formal email: job application · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 3.1 · MODEL TEXT · FORMAL EMAIL: JOB APPLICATION

Application for a part-time job

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the part-time job as a shop assistant which I saw on your website.

I am 20 years old and I am a student at Tashkent State University. I have some work experience: last summer I worked in a café, so I am used to talking to customers. I am friendly, reliable and good at teamwork.

I am free in the evenings and at weekends. I speak Uzbek, Russian and English.

I have attached my CV. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,

Dilshod Karimov

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 3.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Formal and informal language

In a formal email, write full forms (I am, not I’m), use polite phrases and don’t use “Hi” or “Thanks!”. Say why you are writing in the first line.

  • StartDear Sir or Madam, (name unknown) / Dear Mr Brown, (name known)
  • ReasonI am writing to apply for … / I am writing to ask about …
  • Informal → formalI want → I would like · get → receive · ask → enquire
  • Before the endI look forward to hearing from you.
  • EndYours faithfully, (Sir or Madam) / Yours sincerely, (Mr Brown)

UNIT4

Places and Things

Text type: Description of a place · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 4.1 · MODEL TEXT · DESCRIPTION OF A PLACE

My neighbourhood

I live in a quiet residential area in the north of Tashkent. There are lots of tall apartment buildings and there is a big park opposite my flat.

The best thing about my neighbourhood is that everything is within walking distance. Next to my building there is a small supermarket, and there is a bakery at the end of the street. My school is only ten minutes away on foot.

In the evening, families walk in the park and children play football. The only problem is the traffic – the main road is very crowded in the morning.

All in all, it’s a safe and friendly place to live.

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 4.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

There is / there are and describing a place

Use there is with one thing and there are with more than one. Use prepositions to say where things are, and adjectives to say what they are like.

  • There is a park near my home. / There are two schools.
  • There isn’t a cinema. / There aren’t any shops.
  • Placenext to · opposite · behind · in front of · between · near
  • Adjectivesquiet · noisy · crowded · modern · clean · safe · friendly
  • FinishAll in all, … / Overall, it’s a … place to live.
© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 16

UNIT5

Clothes and Shopping

Text type: Email of complaint · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 5.1 · MODEL TEXT · EMAIL OF COMPLAINT

Problem with my order

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a jacket which I ordered from your website on 3 March. My order number is 45219.

When the parcel arrived, the jacket was the wrong size. I ordered a medium, but you sent me a large. Also, one of the buttons was broken.

I would like to exchange the jacket for a medium in the same colour. If this is not possible, could you please give me a full refund? I have kept the receipt.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,

Kamola Rahimova

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 5.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Polite requests and complaints

When you complain, explain the problem clearly and calmly, then say what you want the company to do. Polite requests sound better than orders.

  • ProblemI am writing to complain about … / Unfortunately, …
  • DetailsI ordered … , but … / When it arrived, …
  • RequestI would like to … / Could you please … ?
  • NotGive me my money back! → Could you please give me a refund?
  • EndI look forward to hearing from you.
© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 20

Past Times

Text type: Story: a memorable day · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 6.1 · MODEL TEXT · STORY: A MEMORABLE DAY

An unforgettable day

Last summer, my family and I went to Chimgan mountains for the day. We left home early in the morning because it was a long drive.

When we arrived, the weather was sunny and warm. First, we walked to a beautiful waterfall. Then we had a picnic next to the river. My mum made plov and it was delicious.

In the afternoon, my brother and I went on the cable car. At first I was scared, but the view from the top was amazing!

Suddenly, it started to rain, so we ran back to the car. We got very wet, but we laughed all the way home.

It was one of the best days of my life.

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 6.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Telling a story in the past

Use the past simple for the main events. Use time words to show the order, and add feelings to make your story interesting.

  • Regularwalk → walked · arrive → arrived · stop → stopped
  • Irregulargo → went · see → saw · make → made · eat → ate
  • BeginningLast summer, … / One day, … / A few years ago, …
  • MiddleWhen we arrived, … · At first, … · Suddenly, …
  • EndingIn the end, … / It was one of the best days of my life.

UNIT7

Health and Sport

Text type: Message giving advice · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 7.1 · MODEL TEXT · MESSAGE GIVING ADVICE

Re: I can’t sleep!

Hi Laylo,

I’m sorry to hear that you can’t sleep. Exams are stressful, but don’t worry – here are some ideas.

First of all, you shouldn’t drink coffee or tea in the evening. Have warm milk instead.

I think you should stop using your phone an hour before bed. The light from the screen keeps you awake.

Why don’t you go for a walk or do some exercise in the afternoon? It really helps you relax.

If I were you, I’d also take short breaks when you study.

I hope you feel better soon!

Love,

Nodira

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 7.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Giving advice

Use should / shouldn’t + verb to give advice. Use different phrases to make your message friendly and not repetitive.

  • You should + verbYou should get more sleep.
  • You shouldn’t + verbYou shouldn’t eat junk food.
  • Why don’t you + verb? Why don’t you join a gym?
  • If I were you, I’d + verbIf I were you, I’d see a doctor.
  • FeelingsI’m sorry to hear that … / I hope you feel better soon!

UNIT8

Travel and Adventure

Text type: Travel blog: recommending a place · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 8.1 · MODEL TEXT · TRAVEL BLOG: RECOMMENDING A PLACE

Why you must visit Khiva

If you visit Uzbekistan, you must see Khiva. It’s a small city in the west of the country and it’s definitely worth visiting.

The old town, Itchan Kala, is like an open-air museum. There are ancient mosques, palaces and towers. The best way to see it is on foot, because everything is within walking distance.

The best time to visit is in spring or autumn, because summer is boiling hot. You should stay in a small family hotel – they are cheap and the locals are very friendly.

Don’t forget to try shivit oshi, a green noodle dish. I highly recommend it!

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 8.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Giving reasons and recommending

When you recommend something, give clear reasons. Use because to give a reason and so to give a result.

  • ReasonThe best time to visit is spring because it isn’t too hot.
  • ResultIt’s a small city, so you can walk everywhere.
  • RecommendYou must see … / It’s definitely worth visiting.
  • AdviceYou should … / Don’t forget to …
  • Strong endingI highly recommend it! / You won’t regret it!

UNIT9

Food and Drink

Text type: Restaurant review · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 9.1 · MODEL TEXT · RESTAURANT REVIEW

Review: Silk Road Café ★★★★☆

Last Friday I went to Silk Road Café with two friends. It’s a small restaurant in the city centre, within walking distance of the metro.

The atmosphere was cosy and the waiters were very friendly. We ordered lagman, a fresh salad and some green tea. The lagman was absolutely delicious and the portions were big.

However, we waited 40 minutes for our food, which was too long. The dessert was also a bit too sweet for me.

Overall, it’s a great place for lunch with friends and the prices are reasonable. I’d recommend it, but don’t go if you are in a hurry!

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 9.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Writing a review

A good review has four parts: where and when, what was good, what was not so good, and your final opinion. Use however to show the other side.

  • 1 IntroductionLast Friday I went to … It’s a … in …
  • 2 Good pointsThe food was delicious. The staff were friendly.
  • 3 Bad pointsHowever, … / The only problem was …
  • 4 OpinionOverall, … / I’d recommend it to …
  • Strong adjectivesdelicious · tasty · fresh · spicy · cosy · overpriced

UNIT10

The Natural World

Text type: Description of a natural place · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 10.1 · MODEL TEXT · DESCRIPTION OF A NATURAL PLACE

My favourite place in nature

My favourite place in nature is Charvak Lake, about 80 km from Tashkent. It’s surrounded by high mountains and the water is bright blue.

In summer, it’s much cooler than the city, so many families go there at the weekend. You can swim, go boating or just sit by the water and enjoy the view.

The most beautiful time is early in the morning. It’s peaceful and you can only hear the birds. The air is fresh and clean.

When I’m there, I feel calm and happy. I think it’s one of the most beautiful places in Uzbekistan.

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 10.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Comparing and describing

Use comparatives to compare two things and superlatives to say something is number one. Use the five senses to make your description come alive.

  • Short adjectivescool → cooler than → the coolest
  • Long adjectivesbeautiful → more beautiful than → the most beautiful
  • Irregulargood → better → the best · bad → worse → the worst
  • SensesYou can see … / hear … / smell … / feel …
  • One of the + superlative + plural nounone of the most beautiful places

UNIT11

Communities

Text type: Formal letter: making a suggestion · Opinion paragraph

4pages
UNIT 11.1 · MODEL TEXT · FORMAL LETTER: MAKING A SUGGESTION

A suggestion for our neighbourhood

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to suggest an improvement for our neighbourhood, Yunusabad 5.

At the moment, there is nowhere for children to play. They play football in the car park, which is dangerous. In addition, there is no place for older people to sit outside.

I would like to suggest building a small playground and a garden with benches on the empty land next to School No. 112. Local residents would be happy to help to plant trees and keep the area clean.

I believe this would bring the community together.

Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,

Shahlo Nazarova

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

UNIT 11.2 · LANGUAGE FOCUS

Paragraphs in a formal letter

Plan your letter in paragraphs. Each paragraph has one main idea. Use formal linking words to add ideas and to suggest solutions.

  • Paragraph 1why you are writing — I am writing to suggest / complain about …
  • Paragraph 2the situation now — At the moment, … / In addition, …
  • Paragraph 3your suggestion — I would like to suggest + -ing / I believe this would …
  • Paragraph 4polite ending — Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.
  • Formal linkersIn addition · However · Therefore · As a result

UNIT 12.1 · MODEL TEXT · FILM REVIEW AND OPINION

Film review: The Lion King

I recently watched The Lion King at the cinema with my younger sister. It’s an animated film about a young lion, Simba, who must become king after his father dies.

What I liked most was the music – the songs are fantastic and I still sing them! The animation is beautiful too, and some scenes made me cry.

On the other hand, some parts were a bit scary for small children, and the film is quite long.

In my opinion, it’s a wonderful family film with an important message about responsibility. I’d give it four stars out of five, and I highly recommend it.

Find the highlighted phrases. Which ones can you use in your own writing?

COMMON MISTAKES

Ten-second checks before you finish

Don’t writeWriteWhy?
✗ I am agree with you.✓ I agree with you.agree is a verb — no am
✗ He go to work every day.✓ He goes to work every day.he / she / it + -s
✗ I have 20 years.✓ I am 20 (years old).use be for age
✗ She is teacher.✓ She is a teacher.a / an before jobs
✗ People is very friendly.✓ People are very friendly.people is plural
✗ Yesterday I go to the cinema.✓ Yesterday I went to the cinema.past simple for finished time
✗ I went to home.✓ I went home.no to before home
✗ I can to swim.✓ I can swim.can + verb (no to)
✗ I very like football.✓ I really like football.very doesn’t go before verbs
✗ It was very interesting film.✓ It was a very interesting film.a / an before singular nouns
✗ He explained me the rule.✓ He explained the rule to me.explain something to someone
✗ I need some informations / advices.✓ I need some information / advice.uncountable: no -s
✗ I am living in Tashkent since 2015.✓ I have lived in Tashkent since 2015.present perfect with since / for
✗ I married with Aziz.✓ I am married to Aziz.married to
✗ I listen music every day.✓ I listen to music every day.listen to
✗ dear sir or madam, i am writing …✓ Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing …capital letters: names, I, start of sentences

Model answers · Units 1–2

UNIT 1 · WRITING TASK

Email to a new pen friend

Hi Lucas,

Thanks for your email! Let me tell you about myself. My name is Jasur and I’m from Bukhara. It’s an old city with beautiful mosques and markets.

There are five people in my family: my parents, my two sisters and me. I take after my father – we are both quiet and hard-working.

I’m a student at college and I study IT. In my free time, I play football and watch films.

What about you? What is your city like, and what do you do at weekends?

Write back soon!

Best wishes,

Jasur

UNIT 1 · OPINION

Is it important to learn a foreign language? Why or why not?

In my opinion, it is very important to learn a foreign language.

Firstly, a foreign language gives you more job opportunities. For example, many companies in my country want workers who speak English.

Secondly, you can travel more easily and talk to people from other countries. You can also watch films and read books in the original language.

Of course, learning a language is not easy and it takes a lot of time. However, I think it is worth it.

To sum up, I believe everyone should learn at least one foreign language.

UNIT 2 · WRITING TASK

Blog post: my weekend

My weekend

I love weekends because I can relax! On Saturdays I usually get up at about nine. First, I have a big breakfast with my family. Then I go to the market with my mum.

In the afternoon, I often hang out with my friends. We sometimes play football in the park or go to a café.

In the evening, I unwind at home. I usually watch a film or read a book. On Sundays I visit my grandparents.

Weekends are the best part of the week – I can finally get enough sleep!

UNIT 2 · OPINION

Do people today have enough free time? Give reasons for your answer.

I don’t think people today have enough free time.

Firstly, many people work or study very long hours. For example, my father often works until eight o’clock in the evening.

Secondly, when people have some free time, they often spend it on their phones, so they don’t really relax.

On the other hand, technology helps us save time. We can shop and pay bills online.

To sum up, I believe most people today are too busy and need more real free time.

© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 56
IMPULSELEARNING CENTER A2 WRITING BOOK

Model answers · Units 3–4

UNIT 3 · WRITING TASK

Applying for a summer job

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the summer job at reception which I saw in the City Sports Centre advert.

I am 18 years old and I am in my last year at school. I am friendly and I am good at communicating with people. Last year I helped at a children’s football club, so I have some work experience.

I am free every evening after five o’clock and at weekends.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,

Malika Saidova

UNIT 3 · OPINION

Is it better to have an interesting job or a well-paid job? Give your opinion.

In my opinion, it is better to have an interesting job than a well-paid job.

Firstly, we spend most of our day at work. If the job is interesting, we feel happy and we want to work hard.

Secondly, a boring job can make people stressed and tired, even if the salary is good. For example, my uncle left a well-paid job in a bank because he was unhappy.

However, money is also important, especially for people with families.

To sum up, I think the best job is an interesting one with a fair salary.

UNIT 4 · WRITING TASK

Describing my home

My home

I live in a flat on the fifth floor of a modern building near the city centre. There are three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom.

My favourite room is my bedroom because it is spacious and light. There is a big desk next to the window, so I can see the park when I study.

Near my home there is a metro station and there are some nice cafés.

I like my home because it’s cosy and everything is within walking distance. The only problem is that it’s quite noisy at night.

UNIT 4 · OPINION

Is it better to live in a city or in the countryside? Give reasons.

I think it is better to live in a city, especially for young people.

Firstly, there are more jobs, universities and shops in the city. For example, most good universities in my country are in the capital.

Secondly, it is easier to get around because there is good public transport.

On the other hand, cities are noisy and crowded, and the cost of living is high. The countryside is peaceful and has fresh air.

To sum up, the city is better for studying and working, but the countryside is better for relaxing.

© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 57
IMPULSELEARNING CENTER A2 WRITING BOOK

Model answers · Units 5–6

UNIT 5 · WRITING TASK

My order was wrong

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to complain about a pair of trainers which I ordered from your website last week.

When the parcel arrived, the trainers were black, but I ordered white ones. Also, the box was damaged.

I would like to exchange them for the white trainers in size 40. If this is not possible, could you please give me a refund?

You can contact me by email or phone me on 90 123 45 67.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,

Bekzod Aliyev

UNIT 5 · OPINION

Is shopping online better than shopping in shops? Give your opinion.

In my opinion, online shopping is better for most things, but not for clothes.

Firstly, shopping online is fast and convenient. You can buy things at home, at any time of the day.

Secondly, there is more choice and the prices are often lower. For example, books and electronics are cheaper online.

However, in a shop you can try clothes on and check the quality. When I buy clothes online, they are sometimes the wrong size.

To sum up, I prefer shopping online, but I still buy clothes in shops.

UNIT 6 · WRITING TASK

A day I will never forget

A day I will never forget

Two years ago, I took part in a big chess competition in Samarkand. My father came with me.

At first, I was very nervous because the other players were older than me. I lost my first game and I wanted to give up. My father said, “Don’t give up – try again!”

Then I won three games in a row! In the end, I came second.

I was so proud of myself, and my father was proud of me too. It was an unforgettable day because I learned that hard work is more important than luck.

UNIT 6 · OPINION

Was life better in the past than it is today? Give reasons for your answer.

I think life today is better than in the past, but we lost some good things.

Firstly, we have much better medicine and technology. For example, people live longer and can talk to their families on video calls.

Secondly, it is easier to travel and study. Many young people study abroad today.

On the other hand, in the past people spent more time with their families and life was less stressful.

To sum up, I believe life is better today, but we should spend more time with the people we love.

© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 58
IMPULSELEARNING CENTER A2 WRITING BOOK

Model answers · Units 7–8

UNIT 7 · WRITING TASK

Advice for a friend

Hi Timur,

I’m sorry to hear that you feel tired all the time. Here is some advice.

First of all, you should have a balanced diet. You shouldn’t eat so much junk food – try to eat more fruit and vegetables.

Why don’t you join a gym or go running in the park? Exercise gives you more energy.

If I were you, I’d also go to bed earlier and stop using my phone at night.

I hope you feel better soon!

Take care,

Sardor

UNIT 7 · OPINION

Should schools give students more time for sport? Why or why not?

In my opinion, schools should give students more time for sport.

Firstly, sport keeps children healthy and fit. Nowadays many young people sit for long hours at computers.

Secondly, team sports teach important skills like teamwork and discipline. For example, football players must work together to win.

Some people think students need this time for important subjects like maths. However, exercise also helps students to reduce stress and study better.

To sum up, I believe more sport at school is good for both the body and the mind.

UNIT 8 · WRITING TASK

Recommend a place

You must visit Samarkand

If you come to Uzbekistan, you must visit Samarkand. It’s in the centre of the country and it’s easy to get there by fast train from Tashkent.

Samarkand is famous for the Registan, three beautiful old buildings with blue tiles. It’s a must-see, especially at night when the lights are on.

The best time to visit is in April or October because the weather is warm but not too hot. You should stay in a guest house in the old town – it’s affordable and the owners are friendly.

I highly recommend it – you won’t regret it!

UNIT 8 · OPINION

Is it better to travel alone or with friends? Give your opinion.

In my opinion, it is better to travel with friends.

Firstly, a trip with friends is more fun. You can share good moments and talk about them later.

Secondly, it is cheaper because you can share the cost of hotels and taxis. It is also safer, especially in a new country.

On the other hand, when you travel alone, you are more flexible and you can meet new people more easily.

To sum up, travelling alone can be exciting, but I prefer to travel with my friends.

© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 59
IMPULSELEARNING CENTER A2 WRITING BOOK

Model answers · Units 9–10

UNIT 9 · WRITING TASK

Review a place to eat

Review: Bahor Restaurant

Last month I went to Bahor Restaurant for my mother’s birthday. It’s in Chilanzar, near the big park.

We ordered plov, shashlik and salads. The plov was absolutely delicious and the meat was tender. The atmosphere was cosy and there was live music. For dessert, we had fresh fruit and green tea, which was a perfect end to the meal.

However, the service was quite slow because the restaurant was very busy. It was also a bit overpriced.

Overall, it’s a great place for family celebrations, but you should book a table in advance. I’d recommend it to anyone who loves traditional Uzbek food.

UNIT 9 · OPINION

Should children learn to cook at school? Give your opinion.

In my opinion, children should learn to cook at school.

Firstly, cooking is an important life skill. When young people go to university or start work, they need to make their own meals.

Secondly, cooking lessons teach children about healthy food. This is important because many children eat too much junk food.

Some people say parents can teach cooking at home. However, many parents are too busy.

To sum up, I believe cooking lessons would help children to live healthier lives.

UNIT 10 · WRITING TASK

A beautiful place in my country

The Zaamin Mountains

One of the most beautiful places in my country is Zaamin National Park. It’s in the Jizzakh region, about four hours by car from Tashkent.

The park is surrounded by high mountains and old juniper trees. You can hear rivers and birds, and the air is much fresher than in the city. People go hiking, camping and horse riding there.

In summer it’s cooler than Tashkent, so it’s the best place to escape the heat. At night, the sky is clearer than anywhere else and you can see thousands of stars.

When I’m there, I feel peaceful and free. Everyone should visit Zaamin at least once!

UNIT 10 · OPINION

What can people do to protect the environment? Give your ideas.

There are many things that people can do to protect the environment.

Firstly, we can use public transport or walk and cycle instead of driving. This reduces air pollution in big cities.

Secondly, we should recycle and use less plastic. For example, we can take our own bags to the supermarket.

Thirdly, we can save water and electricity at home. Governments should also plant more trees and control factories.

To sum up, if everyone makes small changes, we can protect nature for future generations.

© Impulse Learning Center · Topics from Navigate Elementary A2 Page 60
IMPULSELEARNING CENTER A2 WRITING BOOK

Model answers · Units 11–12

UNIT 11 · WRITING TASK

Write to your local council

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to tell you about a problem in our area, Sergeli 7.

At the moment, there is nothing for teenagers to do in the evenings. As a result, many young people spend hours on their phones or stand in the street. In addition, the old sports ground is broken and dirty.

I would like to suggest repairing the sports ground and opening a small youth club in the empty building near the market.

I believe this would keep young people healthy and bring the community together.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,

Akmal Tursunov

UNIT 11 · OPINION

Should young people do volunteer work? Give reasons for your opinion.

In my opinion, young people should do some volunteer work.

Firstly, volunteering helps young people to gain experience. They can learn new skills and put this experience on their CV.

Secondly, they help people in need, for example, elderly neighbours or children in hospital. This makes them feel useful and happy.

Some people say students are too busy with their studies. However, even two hours a month can make a difference.

To sum up, I believe volunteer work is good for young people and for the whole community.

UNIT 12 · WRITING TASK

Review a film or series

Review: Spider-Man: No Way Home

I recently watched Spider-Man: No Way Home with my friends. It’s an action film about Peter Parker, who asks a doctor to help him, but everything goes wrong.

What I liked most were the special effects – the fights look amazing on a big screen. The main actor’s performance was also very good and the story was funny and moving.

On the other hand, the film is quite long and some parts were confusing if you haven’t seen the other films.

I’d give it four stars out of five. It’s well worth watching if you like superheroes!

UNIT 12 · OPINION

Is it better to watch films at home or at the cinema? Give your opinion.

In my opinion, it is better to watch new films at the cinema, but home is better for everyday watching.

Firstly, at the cinema the screen and sound are much better. Action films and cartoons are more exciting on a big screen.

Secondly, going to the cinema is a social activity. You can go with friends and talk about the film afterwards.

On the other hand, watching at home is cheaper and more comfortable, and you can pause the film.

To sum up, I go to the cinema for big films and watch other films at home.
